selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently configure kernel boot parameter audit=1
selected_evidence.summary: Both pre-reboot configuration and post-reboot bootloader inspection show `audit=1` in the installed kernel entry.

selected_evidence.requirement: Boot the kernel with audit=1 while retaining the installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot `/proc/cmdline` contains `audit=1`; kernel logs report `audit_enabled=1`. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 match the baseline.

Baseline boot ID was `dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e`; systemd acknowledged the safe reboot; the new boot ID is `1ecb0599-4059-48b6-a9c2-cc4318cd9ad5`; node1 recovered to `running` with zero failed units.
